test_title: PYST 5: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 29 Jul, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Choose the correct one-word substitution for:
"The killing of a whole group of people."
solution:
The correct answer is: **3) Genocide**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Genocide"** refers to the deliberate killing of a large number of people, especially those belonging to a particular ethnic group, nation, or race. (नरसंहार)
 
 
• **Example:** The United Nations established the Genocide Convention to prevent acts of genocide after the atrocities of World War II.
 
 
• Genocide is considered one of the most heinous crimes against humanity, and international laws aim to prevent and punish such acts.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Genocide**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Fratricide** (भ्रातृहत्या): The act of killing one’s own brother or someone from the same group.
 
 
• **Example:** The story of Cain and Abel in the Bible is a famous example of fratricide.
 
 
 
 
• **Honorary** (मानद): Given as a mark of respect, without the usual requirements or qualifications.
 
 
• **Example:** The university awarded her an honorary degree for her contributions to science.
 
 
 
 
• **Suicide** (आत्महत्या): The act of intentionally causing one's own death.
 
 
• **Example:** Mental health awareness is crucial to prevent cases of suicide.
 
 

47:Tf1c,

सही उत्तर है: **3) नरसंहार (Genocide)**।
